question: What is the efficacy of merely hearing and knowing this teaching for the practitioner?
premises: The teaching can be merely known.
The teaching can be merely heard.
The fair-faced one is addressed regarding this.
inference: Even mere knowledge and hearing of this teaching carries significance for the practitioner.
uncertainties: The sentence continues into the next verse, so the full consequence is not stated here.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge and by what is heard...
